name: ZONOS3-Mini (Zyphra)
usage: Speech synthesis: fast, 43 languages, cloning and voice design

parameters_total_b.note: sparse mixture of experts, about 0.1B active

formats.value: official: mostly .pt/.bin/.pth plus a gguf folder; mlx-community: safetensors, JSON and .npz (speaker-encoder front end and preset voice embeddings)

languages.value: 43 languages including French and German; preset voices Gaspard (fr), Liesel and Wolfgang (de)

runtimes.value: mlx-audio (native zonos3 model, mlx-community build listed in its README); ggml/Metal

provenance.value: strong: conversion.json names Zyphra revision d78708d6 and three source GGUF files whose sha256 match the official ones exactly; "Q4_0/Q8_0 repacked without requantization", so the backbone is Zyphra's own quantised release
provenance.note: uploaded 09.11.2026 by the main mlx-audio maintainer, author of PR #1162 (merged); 424 downloads; Zyphra also publishes the source GGUF files

web.scope: Released 09.11.2026 (six days before the search): all comments since release. Hacker News (none), Hugging Face discussions, mlx-audio issues (none). Reddit unreadable. **Feedback very thin.**
web.summary: Too new for real feedback. Skips the typographic apostrophe, confirmed by the publisher with a fix promised; publisher claims real time on an M3 MacBook Air.
web.verdict: Very new and fast; skips typographic apostrophes (fix promised)

comments.text: Skips the curly apostrophe (’), e.g. "nurse’s" read as "nurse"; Zyphra confirms and promises a text normaliser ([HF #4, 13.11.2026](https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini/discussions/4)).

Urdu cloning good but pronunciation inconsistent, 15.3 % word error rate measured by Zyphra ([HF #3, 12.11.2026](https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini/discussions/3)); any language works with any voice ([HF #1, 11.11.2026](https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS3-Mini/discussions/1)).
